title: Event
description: The envelope pushed over WS /ws/runs/{id}. Every UI update is one of these. See docs/EVENT_PROTOCOL.md.

id.description: Monotonic per-run event id; clients resume with ?since=.

seq.description: Ordinal within the run. Gaps mean the client missed events and should refetch.

data.description: Payload matching the event type: the full Run, Agent, Message, Scenario, Finding or Report object, or a partial patch for *_changed events.
